title: Localized integral normalization of the rational Hom counit
statement: For a HomIdentification, the normalized rational closed counit at the localized integral representatives of K and M equals the localization of the completed ordinary evaluation map specified by the identification.

source.place: Finite-extension evaluation square, normalization and localization substeps.

proof.text: Normalize the rational internal-Hom object using rationalDerivedInternalHom_existsUnique. The rational braiding is the localization of the integral braiding by its uniqueness specification, and rationalEvaluation_normalization (the proved private helper in NormalizedRationalEvaluationNaturality, accessed by a proof-only import all) identifies evaluation with localized integral evaluation. Transport the tensor endpoints using rationalDerivedTensor_existsUnique and compose the heterogeneous equalities. Functor.map_comp gives localization of the integral composite.

For the permitted integral pair P, specialize the inverse-transpose completion normalization to the identity of its internal Hom. Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_id identifies the resulting ambient transpose with the canonical counit. Apply ordinaryCompletedTensor_adjoint_square to the two integral inputs (P.first, Hom(P)), postcompose with integral evaluation, and use leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit. Cancel the invertible supplied completion map to obtain the required inverse-completion ordinary-counit formula.

Apply the localization functor to the integral equality, use full-subcategory Hom extensionality, and compose with the rational normalization of the first step. This proves the original HEq with precisely the original endpoints and witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph 1: separate rational localization and the formal counit calculation from the integral tensor-completion square.

mathlib_searches.results: Found the private rationalEvaluation_normalization theorem in NormalizedRationalEvaluationNaturality; its localization identity is the required categorical step but is not exported to this module.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedCounit_localized_integral
    (w : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (A : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X E w)
    (h : HomIdentification l E X D hl w A)
    (K M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    HEq (normalizedCounit D l hl X E h.permitted
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj M))
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := (@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ X
            (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X)).obj
              (K, (constructibleIntegralHom l E X).obj
                (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E X
                  ⟨(op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K),
                    (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj M), h.permitted _ _⟩)))
          (Y := M)
          ((@asIso _ _ _ _ (A.completion.map.app
            (K.obj, ((integralDerivedInternalHom l E X).obj (op K.obj, M.obj))))
            (A.completion.invertible K
              ((constructibleIntegralHom l E X).obj
                (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E X
                  ⟨(op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K),
                    (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj M), h.permitted _ _⟩)))).inv ≫
            (A.ordinary.adjunction K.obj).counit.app M.obj)))
